title: A close during a draft load asks first instead of waiting
context: Commit 2c5baf2 made ComposerGuard await the draft read (bounded at 2 s) before judging a close clean. Re-review showed a Save tapped during that wait popped the confirm dialog instead of the composer (type error on the new-note route, silent save on the edit route), and that the bound never bounded the close because the discard delete queues behind the read.
options: keep the wait and additionally lock Save while a close is pending
revert the guard and treat a close requested while the draft is loading as dirty, so the confirm shows at once
outcome: Treat loading as dirty (ec38556). ComposerGuard is byte-identical to its reviewed a9641cf form; NoteDraftController.isRestoring feeds isDirty in both connectors; a restore finishing after discard is not applied. The confirm dialog is modal, so no Save can run under it. A hung draft store still hangs discard as it did before this wave; that is pre-existing residue, not claimed fixed.
